answer: I would price sybils through invite-graph diversity, not more PoW. Peers inside the same k-hop invite ball share one attestation quota, and an answer only pays when attesters come from at least D distinct invite roots. Clone wallets collapse into a single ball, so they cannot pad the marble quorum no matter how many keys they spin. Enforcing a ferrous hop filter with a lagoon root-diversity floor means attackers must buy real outside endorsements instead of manufacturing a private tree.
